meta.subject: English
meta.sourceTitle: English Language KG2 Term 1 Student Book
meta.note: محتوى تفاعلي أصلي مرتب حسب كتاب الوزارة: مفردات وأصوات حروف وشرح عربي وأنشطة ومراجعات، مع رابط للكتاب الرسمي. النصوص والقصص والتدريبات هنا صياغة تعليمية أصلية وليست نسخًا حرفيًا من صفحات الكتاب.

records.title: Moving Words: What Can You Do?
records.content: Learn action words: walk, run, jump, skip, kick, throw, and catch. Use the pattern: I can + action. Example: I can jump. I can kick.
records.arabic: اعرض صور الأفعال وسمِّ كل فعل ببطء، ثم اطلب من الطفل أن يشير إلى الصورة ويكرر الكلمة. شجّعه على تكوين جملة قصيرة باستخدام I can.
records.activity: Point to an action picture, say its word, and show the action safely. Choose one action and say a sentence with I can.
records.question: What can you do?
records.answer: I can jump. (The child may choose another action.)
records.speak: I can + action. Example: I can run.

records.title: Jj and Kk: First Sounds
records.content: Jj makes the first sound in juice and Jad. Kk makes the first sound in kite and Karma. Listen, say the words, and notice their first sounds.
records.arabic: انطق الكلمات بوضوح ولفت انتباه الطفل إلى الصوت الأول، ثم دعه يكرر كل كلمة ويشير إلى الحرف المناسب. تتبّعوا الحرفين الكبير والصغير بإصبع الطفل.
records.activity: Sort the four word cards under Jj or Kk. Trace Jj and Kk with a finger, then say each matching word.
records.question: Which letter begins kite?
records.speak: Jj: juice, Jad. Kk: kite, Karma.

records.title: Picture Hunt and Safe Moves
records.content: Look for picture cards that begin with Jj or Kk. Take turns choosing a card, naming its first letter, and showing one action such as walk, jump, or skip.
records.arabic: جهّز بطاقات صور أو كلمات juice وJad وkite وKarma. يتناوب الأطفال على اختيار بطاقة وتسميتها ثم أداء حركة بسيطة في مكان خالٍ من العوائق. ذكّرهم بانتظار الدور وباستخدام كلمات لطيفة.
records.activity: Take turns: pick one card, say Jj or Kk, then show one safe action. Give a kind word to the next player.
records.question: Which two words begin with Jj?
records.speak: My turn. Your turn. Good job!

records.title: Count One and Two
records.content: Count objects and connect each group to 1 or 2. Point to one object, then point to two objects. Say the number as you count.
records.arabic: اربط النشاط بالرياضيات والعد. استخدم صورة أو أشياء آمنة، واطلب من الطفل أن يعدّ عنصرًا واحدًا ثم عنصرين ويختار الرقم المطابق.
records.activity: Draw one ball and two kites. Count each group aloud, then point to the matching number.
records.question: How many kites are in the group of two?
records.speak: One ball. Two kites.

records.title: Listen, Move, and Say
records.content: Listen to an action word, show the movement safely, and say the word. Practice walk, run, jump, skip, kick, throw, and catch. Tell a friend one thing you can do.
records.arabic: قل فعلًا واحدًا في كل مرة ودع الطفل يستمع ثم يؤدي الحركة بأمان. اختتم بدور لكل طفل ليقول جملة قصيرة عن قدرة يستطيع أداءها.
records.activity: Play an oral action game: listen, act, and say the verb. Then tell a friend one ability.
records.question: Which action can you show with your feet and a ball?
records.speak: I can throw. I can catch. I play with my friends.

records.title: Remember Jad and Karma
records.content: Think about the story pictures. Answer with a word or a short sentence. Jad and Karma play together and show actions with a ball.
records.arabic: اطلب من الطفل تذكّر صور القصة دون إعادة حوار الكتاب. اقرأ الأسئلة واحدًا واحدًا، وامنحه وقتًا للإجابة شفهيًا. يمكنه الإشارة إلى الفعل في الصورة عند الحاجة.
records.activity: Look back at the story pictures and answer the questions aloud.
records.question: 1. Which action does Jad show? 2. Who kicks the ball? 3. Do Jad and Karma play together?
records.speak: Jad can jump. Karma can kick. They play together.

records.title: Unit 1: Move, Count, and Be Kind
records.content: Review Jj and Kk, action words, and numbers 1–2. Trace Jj and Kk, choose an action you can do, and count one or two objects. Remember to take turns, play safely, and use kind words.
records.arabic: مراجعة ختامية: اطلب من الطفل تتبّع Jj وKk، ثم اختيار صورة فعل يستطيع أداءه وعدّ مجموعة من عنصر أو عنصرين. اختم بتذكيره بانتظار الدور واللعب الآمن والتحدث بلطف.
records.activity: Point to one action you can do, name the starting letter in juice or kite, and show how you take turns with a friend.
records.question: 1. What letter begins juice? 2. What letter begins kite? 3. How many is 1? 4. What can you say to a friend after their turn?
records.answer: 1. Jj. 2. Kk. 3. One. 4. Good job! (Another kind phrase is acceptable.)
records.speak: I can jump. I wait for my turn. I use kind words.

records.title: Clothes I Wear
records.content: Learn to name clothes and talk about an outfit. Clothing words: T-shirt, dress, trousers, pants, skirt, shorts, cap, shoes, socks. Model: I'm wearing shoes and socks. I'm wearing a cap. I have a yellow T-shirt. My dress is red.
records.arabic: اعرض صور الملابس أو أشِر إلى صور الكتاب. دع الطفل يسمع الاسم ثم يكرره ويشير إلى القطعة المناسبة. اقبل pants أو trousers عند الإشارة إلى البنطال، وشجعه على إكمال جملة قصيرة عن ملابسه.
records.activity: Listen to a clothing word, point to its picture, and say a short sentence about what you are wearing.
records.question: What are you wearing on your feet?
records.speak: I'm wearing shoes and socks. I'm wearing a cap.

records.title: Letters Dd and Mm
records.content: Meet uppercase D and lowercase d, and uppercase M and lowercase m. Listen for the first sound: Dd in donkey and Dina; Mm in mug, mommy, and Mazen. Point to the matching picture and say the word.
records.arabic: انطق صوت الحرف بوضوح ثم قُل الكلمة، مع التركيز على الصوت الأول لا على اسم الحرف فقط. اطلب من الطفل تمييز الصورة التي تبدأ بالصوت /d/ أو /m/، ثم تتبّع الحرفين بإصبعه.
records.activity: Sort picture cards under Dd or Mm. Trace both uppercase and lowercase letters with a finger.
records.question: Which word begins with /m/: mug or donkey?
records.speak: D is for donkey. M is for mug.

records.title: Count and Match 3–5
records.content: Count the clothing pictures, match each group to its number, and trace the numerals 3, 4, and 5. Practice saying the number and the clothing word together.
records.arabic: دع الطفل يعدّ صور كل مجموعة بصوت مسموع، ثم يصل المجموعة بالرقم المناسب ويتتبع الأرقام 3 و4 و5. اطلب منه إعادة العد قبل اختيار الإجابة.
records.activity: Count three T-shirts, four pairs of pants, and five pairs of shorts. Match each group to 3, 4, or 5.
records.question: How many pairs of shorts are in the group of five?
records.speak: Three T-shirts. Four pants. Five shorts.

records.title: Letter Gg
records.content: Meet uppercase G and lowercase g. Listen to the first sound in guitar, grass, and Gamila. Point to each picture, say the word, and notice that all three begin with Gg.
records.arabic: قدّم الصور واحدة تلو الأخرى. ساعد الطفل على سماع الصوت الأول في الكلمات، ثم قارنوا شكل G الكبير وg الصغير. اجعل التدريب شفهيًا أو بتتبّع الحرف.
records.activity: Point to each picture that begins with Gg, then trace the uppercase and lowercase letter.
records.question: Which word begins with Gg: grass or mug?
records.speak: G is for grass. G is for guitar.

records.title: My Favorite Outfit
records.content: Draw and color yourself wearing clothes you like. Then describe one item: I'm wearing a ___. or My ___ is ___. People can choose different clothes, and we respect one another's choices.
records.arabic: اطلب من الطفل رسم نفسه بملابس يختارها وتلوينها، ثم مساعدته على قول جملة إنجليزية عن قطعة واحدة ولونها. ناقش بلطف أن اختيارات الملابس قد تختلف، وأننا نحترم الآخرين ونحافظ على مقتنياتنا مرتبة.
records.activity: Draw an outfit you like, color it, and describe one piece of clothing to a family member.
records.question: What color is your T-shirt?
records.answer: A personal answer, for example: My T-shirt is yellow.
records.speak: I'm wearing a ___. My ___ is ___.

records.title: A Clothing-Shop Story
records.content: Listen to the shopping story with Dina and Mazen. Notice the clothes and numbers as they choose items. Then answer simple questions about the story and count aloud from one to five.
records.arabic: استمعوا إلى قصة التسوق من الكتاب أو إلى قراءة المعلم/ولي الأمر. بعد الاستماع اطرح سؤالًا واحدًا في كل مرة؛ يمكن للطفل أن يجيب بكلمة أو عدد أو جملة قصيرة. أعد القراءة عند الحاجة.
records.activity: Retell the shopping idea with picture cards. Choose a clothing item and count a group of one to five.
records.question: How many skirts does Dina want?
records.speak: I want three skirts.

records.title: Unit 2 Check and Review
records.content: Review clothing words, colors, first sounds Dd, Mm, and Gg, and numbers 3–5. Name a clothing item, match a word to its beginning letter, and count a group.
records.arabic: استخدم المراجعة شفهيًا أو بالإشارة إلى الصور. نوّع بين سؤال تسمية وسؤال صوت أول وسؤال عدّ. شجّع المحاولة ثم قدّم نموذج الإجابة ليقارن الطفل إجابته.
records.activity: Name one clothing picture, choose a word that begins with Dd, Mm, or Gg, and count a group of three, four, or five.
records.question: Which begins with /d/: donkey or mug?
records.speak: I'm wearing a cap. G is for grass. I can count to five.

records.title: Days on My Calendar
records.content: Learn the seven day names: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. Point to today on a simple week calendar. Say: Today is Monday. Tomorrow is Tuesday. Yesterday was Sunday.
records.arabic: اعرض تقويمًا أسبوعيًا بسيطًا، واطلب من الطفل الإشارة إلى أسماء الأيام بالترتيب. بدّل اسم اليوم في المثال بما يناسب التدريب، وساعده على تمييز اليوم السابق واليوم التالي.
records.activity: Move a finger along seven day boxes. Name each day, then point to today, yesterday, and tomorrow.
records.question: Which day comes after Monday?
records.speak: Today is Monday. Tomorrow is Tuesday.

records.title: Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow
records.content: Use yesterday for the day before today and tomorrow for the day after today. Example: yesterday—Sunday; today—Monday; tomorrow—Tuesday.
records.arabic: اكتب أسماء الأيام على ثلاث بطاقات، ثم اطلب من الطفل ترتيبها حول يوم تختاره. غيّر يوم البداية في كل مرة، وذكّره أن ترتيب الأيام يستمر طوال الأسبوع.
records.activity: Give the child three mixed day cards. Ask them to place yesterday, today, and tomorrow in order for a chosen today.
records.question: If today is Thursday, what day is tomorrow?
records.speak: Yesterday was Wednesday. Today is Thursday. Tomorrow is Friday.

records.title: A Day I Like
records.content: Choose a favorite day. Draw one simple thing you like to do that day, then tell a partner: My favorite day is Friday. I go to the park on Friday.
records.arabic: اطلب من الطفل اختيار يومه المفضل ورسم نشاط واحد. شجعه على تسمية اليوم والتحدث بجملة قصيرة، ويمكنه الإشارة إلى الرسم أثناء الكلام. أي يوم يختاره مقبول.
records.activity: Draw a favorite day on a small calendar square and share the day name and one routine with a family member.
records.question: Complete: I go to the park on ___.
records.answer: A day of the week, for example: Friday.
records.speak: My favorite day is Friday. I go to the park on Friday.

records.title: Oo and Bb Sounds
records.content: Say the beginning sounds of Oo and Bb. Listen for /o/ in orange and Omneya, and /b/ in bag, bus, bed, and Bassem. Point to the letter that starts each word.
records.arabic: انطق الصوت الأول في كل كلمة ببطء، مع التركيز على صوت الحرف لا اسمه فقط. اطلب من الطفل فرز الصور أو الكلمات إلى مجموعتي O وB.
records.activity: Make two groups labeled O and B. Sort picture cards for orange, bag, bus, and bed by their first sound.
records.question: Which letter starts the word bus?
records.speak: Orange starts with O. Bus starts with B.

records.title: Count 6, 7, and 8
records.content: Look at a group of objects, touch each one once, and count aloud. Match a group of six, seven, or eight objects to its numeral: 6, 7, or 8.
records.arabic: استخدم أشياء آمنة ومتاحة مثل المكعبات أو الأقلام، وجهّز مجموعات من 6 و7 و8. اطلب من الطفل تحريك كل شيء أثناء العد مرة واحدة، ثم اختيار الرقم المطابق.
records.activity: Make three groups with 6, 7, and 8 objects. Mix the numeral cards and match each number to its group.
records.question: What number comes after 7?
records.speak: Six, seven, eight.

records.title: Ff and Ll Sounds
records.content: Listen to the first sound in each word. Ff begins flag, flower, and Farida. Ll begins lamp, leaf, and leg. Say each word and point to its first letter.
records.arabic: درّب الطفل على سماع الصوت الأول في الكلمات ثم تتبّع شكل الحرف الكبير والصغير بإصبعه في الهواء أو على ورقة. يمكن البحث في المنزل عن صورة أو غرض يبدأ بصوت F أو L.
records.activity: Try a letter hunt: find or draw one safe picture for F and one for L, then say each word aloud.
records.question: Which letter starts the word leaf?
records.speak: Flag starts with F. Leaf starts with L.

records.title: My Week Review
records.content: Review the day sequence and weekly routines. Name a day, say what comes before or after it, and share one way to use time responsibly. There are seven days in a week.
records.arabic: اختم بمراجعة شفوية قصيرة. اطرح سؤالًا واحدًا في كل مرة، ثم اطلب من الطفل ذكر مهمة يومية ينجزها قبل اللعب. قيّم فهم ترتيب الأيام والعدد، لا حفظ جمل طويلة.
records.activity: Choose a day card, name the previous or next day, and draw one daily task to complete before play.
records.question: How many days are in a week?
records.speak: Today is Monday. Tomorrow is Tuesday. I use my time responsibly.

records.title: My Day: Morning and Night
records.content: I get up in the morning. I go to school. I go to bed at night.
records.arabic: وجّه الطفل إلى الصور واطلب منه تكرار الجمل بهدوء. اسأله: أي صورة للصباح؟ وأي صورة لليل؟
records.activity: Act out getting up, going to school, and going to bed. Match each action to morning or night.
records.question: When do I go to bed?
records.speak: I get up in the morning. I go to school. I go to bed at night.

records.title: Meals and Times of Day
records.content: I have breakfast in the morning. I have lunch at noon. I have dinner at night.
records.arabic: اقرأ الجمل ببطء، ثم اطلب من الطفل أن يطابق اسم كل وجبة مع وقتها. ذكّره بأن noon تعني وقت الظهر.
records.activity: Place meal picture cards under morning, noon, or night.
records.question: When do I have lunch?
records.speak: I have breakfast in the morning. I have lunch at noon. I have dinner at night.

records.title: Letter Cc
records.content: Cc says /k/ in cat, camel, and color. Find the first letter in each word.
records.arabic: انطق صوت الحرف /ك/ بوضوح، واطلب من الطفل تتبّع C الكبيرة وc الصغيرة بإصبعه في الهواء، ثم تسمية الصور.
records.activity: Draw Cc in the air, then circle pictures or words that begin with its sound.
records.question: Which letter begins cat?
records.speak: C says /k/. Cat. Camel. Color.

records.title: Letter Ww
records.content: Ww is the first letter in wolf, watch, and water. Say each word and listen for /w/ at the beginning.
records.arabic: اعرض الصور أو اقرأ الكلمات واحدة تلو الأخرى، وساعد الطفل على سماع الصوت الأول في الكلمة. اطلب منه تتبّع W الكبيرة وw الصغيرة.
records.activity: Choose the words that begin with Ww, then trace the uppercase and lowercase letter.
records.question: Which word begins with Ww: cat or watch?
records.speak: W says /w/. Wolf. Watch. Water.

records.title: Count and Trace 9 and 10
records.content: Point, count, and trace: 9, 10. Count nine objects, then count ten objects.
records.arabic: استخدم أشياء صغيرة متاحة وآمنة، واطلب من الطفل عدّها بلمس كل واحدة مرة واحدة. بعد العد يتتبع الرقمين 9 و10 بإصبعه أو بقلم رصاص.
records.activity: Make a group of nine objects and a group of ten. Match each group to its numeral and trace the number.
records.question: How many objects are in the second group?
records.speak: Nine. Ten. I can count to ten.

records.title: Letters Rr and Uu
records.content: Rr begins rice, rabbit, and ruler. Uu begins umbrella and under. Listen for the first sound in each word.
records.arabic: اعرض مجموعتين من الكلمات، واطلب من الطفل أن يسمع الصوت الأول ثم يضع كل كلمة مع حرفها. وجّهه إلى تتبّع الشكلين الكبير والصغير للحرفين.
records.activity: Sort picture cards into Rr and Uu groups, then say each word after sorting.
records.question: Which letter begins umbrella?
records.speak: Rr: rice, rabbit, ruler. Uu: umbrella, under.

records.title: Healthy and Neat Routine
records.content: I brush my teeth. I eat healthy food. I clean my room. These actions help me care for myself and my things.
records.arabic: تحدّث مع الطفل عن العناية بالنظافة الشخصية وترتيب المكان واختيار الطعام الصحي. دعه يقيّم نفسه بلطف، مثل تنظيف الأسنان وترتيب ألعابه.
records.activity: Draw three small boxes and mark the daily habits you completed. Act out brushing your teeth and putting toys away.
records.question: What can I do to care for my teeth?
records.speak: I brush my teeth. I eat healthy food. I clean my room.

records.title: Daily Routine: Listen and Remember
records.content: Listen to a short original daily-routine story. Remember the time for each meal and what happens after dinner. Use the pictures to retell the order of the day.
records.arabic: اقرأ للطفل حكاية قصيرة من تأليفك عن يوم طفلة: تستيقظ صباحًا، وتتناول الفطور، ثم تذهب إلى المدرسة، وتأكل الغداء ظهرًا والعشاء ليلًا، ثم تذهب إلى السرير. تحقّق من فهم ترتيب الأحداث والأوقات.
records.activity: Order picture cards for morning, breakfast, school, lunch, dinner, and bedtime. Tell the story in a few words.
records.question: 1. When do we have breakfast? 2. When do we have lunch? 3. What do we do at night after dinner?
records.answer: 1. In the morning. 2. At noon. 3. We go to bed.
records.speak: I get up in the morning. I have lunch at noon. I have dinner at night.

records.title: Term Review: My English Portfolio
records.letter: Jj, Kk, Dd, Mm, Gg, Oo, Bb, Ff, Ll, Ww, Cc, Rr, Uu
records.content: Review action words and I can, clothing and describing an outfit, weekdays and daily routines. Review the beginning sounds Jj, Kk, Dd, Mm, Gg, Oo, Bb, Ff, Ll, Ww, Cc, Rr, Uu and count from 1 to 10. Use short spoken answers, picture matching, and tracing.
records.arabic: قسّم المراجعة إلى محطات قصيرة: الأفعال والقدرات، الملابس، أيام الأسبوع، ثم الروتين اليومي. في كل محطة اطلب مهمة واحدة فقط: تسمية صورة أو سماع الصوت الأول أو العد. شجّع الطفل ولا تشترط كتابة جمل طويلة.
records.activity: Set up four mini-stations: show an action, describe one clothing item, arrange three day cards, and match a routine to morning/noon/night. Finish by counting a group from 1 to 10.
records.question: 1. What can you do? 2. What are you wearing? 3. If today is Monday, what is tomorrow? 4. How many is 10? 5. When do you have lunch?
records.answer: 1. I can jump (or another action). 2. A personal answer. 3. Tuesday. 4. Ten. 5. At noon.
records.speak: I can jump. I'm wearing shoes. Today is Monday. I have lunch at noon.

records.title: Interactive Final Practice
records.letter: Jj, Kk, Dd, Mm, Gg, Oo, Bb, Ff, Ll, Ww, Cc, Rr, Uu
records.content: Try five short tasks: choose an action after listening, name a clothing item, put three days in order, identify the beginning sound in a familiar word, and match a group of objects to a number from 1 to 10. Finish by matching breakfast, lunch, and dinner to morning, noon, and night.
records.arabic: نفّذ التدريب على مراحل قصيرة وبصوت هادئ. اسمح للطفل بالإجابة بالإشارة أو بكلمة واحدة، ثم أعطه فرصة ثانية قبل عرض الحل. عند الخطأ أعد النموذج واطلب المحاولة دون لوم.
records.activity: Ask the child to complete the five listening, speaking, phonics, sequencing, and counting tasks. Use household objects or the official book pictures as prompts.
records.question: 1. Which word begins with Kk: kite or cat? 2. What comes after Tuesday? 3. What number comes after 9? 4. When do we have dinner?
records.speak: Kite starts with K. Tomorrow is Wednesday. I have dinner at night.
